title: Sage reverb record
description: A reverb record (ReverbRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another reverb record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

mix.description: How much of the reverb is heard: the wet level, 0 = dry. Range: 0 to 1. (float, default 0.5)

decayTime.description: How long the tail rings. Unit: s. Range: 0.1 to 20. (float, default 1.49)

decayHFRatio.description: High-frequency decay relative to the rest: below 1 is a soft room, above 1 a hard one. Range: 0.1 to 2. (float, default 0.83)

density.description: Modal density of the tail: low is grainy, 1 smooth. Range: 0 to 1. (float, default 1)

diffusion.description: Echo density: low hears separate echoes, 1 a wash. Range: 0 to 1. (float, default 1)

gain.description: Overall reverb level. Range: 0 to 1. (float, default 0.32)

gainHF.description: High-frequency level of the reverb: low is muffled. Range: 0 to 1. (float, default 0.89)

reflectionsGain.description: Level of the early reflections. Range: 0 to 3.16. (float, default 0.05)

reflectionsDelay.description: Delay before the early reflections. Unit: s. Range: 0 to 0.3. (float, default 0.007)

lateGain.description: Level of the late reverb, relative to the reflections. Range: 0 to 10. (float, default 1.26)

lateDelay.description: Delay of the late reverb after the reflections. Unit: s. Range: 0 to 0.1. (float, default 0.011)
